id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

parentAsset.description: The parent asset that represents the whole process flow diagram.

componentAsset.description: The component asset that represents one component in the process flow diagram.

left.description:
The X-coordinate (in percentage) of the left side of the tooltip bounding box.
0% is the left of the image, 100% is the right of the image.

top.description:
The Y-coordinate (in percentage) of the top side of the tooltip bounding box.
0% is the top of the image, 100% is the bottom of the image.

width.description: The width (in percentage) of the tooltip bounding box.

height.description: The height (in percentage) of the tooltip bounding box.

dotX.description: The x-coordinate (in percentage) of the colored dot. 0% is the left of the image, 100% is the right of the image.

dotY.description: The y-coordinate (in percentage) of the colored dot. 0% is the top of the image, 100% is the bottom of the image.

title: Configuration for one component in a {@link UiSdlProcessFlowDiagram}.
name: ProcessDiagramConfig
